description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart labeled “Stimuli Type” that represents the distribution of stimulus categories across a total of 38 items, shown as 6 slices. The slices are labeled with counts out of 38 and can be approximated as percentages: External News Article is a dark green slice at 15/38 (about 39%); Draft/Other is a dark red slice at 9/38 (about 24%); Email is a dark maroon slice at 5/38 (about 13%); Press Release is a mustard/yellow slice at 4/38 (about 11%); Interview is a dark navy slice at 2/38 (about 5%); and Intra-agency news article is a small orange slice at 1/38 (about 3%). Labels are placed outside the ring rather than as percentage labels inside slices, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices appear arranged around the ring without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme.
